authorInstruction: 按照理解修改本次组装的特效：颜色独立可调、烟雾使用原生受控随机分布。
geometrySource: V1 native-recipe (captured actual source painter); retain contours and UV layout, planar smoke mesh aspect .88.

texture.name: BuildFX_Masks.png
texture.format: RGBA8 data atlas: neutral smoke/glow shading plus palette role/shade/alpha blocks

maskContract.smoke: UV.x<.625 and UV.y>.60: neutral RGB shading, original alpha
maskContract.glow: UV.x<.625 and UV.y<=.60: neutral radial RGB, original alpha
maskContract.palette: UV.x>=.625: role=round(R*8), G=shade, A=source element opacity

nativeAdaptation: One smoke system, three timed bursts, random box domain in local XY, random mesh/size/lifetime/velocity/rotation and small planar Noise. Keep three flash timings; no per-puff fixed nodes.
colors: Material palette parameters define independent roles; native Start Color and Color over Lifetime multiply them. Two shared blend materials, no per-role material proliferation.
boundaries: Random layouts preserve range and timing, not source particle identities.
Default live stochastic systems use Auto Random Seed; fixed seeds are only for comparison.
